notes.title: Grow the Seed Demo Update v.3.1.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43731981/bc2295557ef6cda8a9d6ba759eb28e7d546183a9.png

Hello everyone~ 

We gladly announce the newest update for the Grow the Seed Demo! In this version, v.3.1.0, we listen and gather all of your feedbacks and updates the demo with love and dedicated it all for our beloved players and community.

Here's the list of all the update we've made:


UI Changes: We have changed the UI design and visual according to your feedbacks to make it even more neat and tidy but still informative towards you, our dearest players.

Card Visual Changes: The card's design and visual have also undergone a change, the new design serves to be easier to read and seen by.

Calendar and Day System Changes: Now with the updated mechanics in Calendar and Day System, you will able to meet with the Merchant at the end of each week, and the Battle Day will happen only on particular week. So, prepare and plan your weeks carefully.

2 New Quests: With the appearance of 2 new Spirits, Cibo and Enoli, comes 2 new Quest each come from each Spirit. Complete the Quests and gain all rewards specially given by the Spirits to you.

Convert Leftover Miracles Mechanic: Introducing new mechanic in the game, the Convert Leftover Miracles system, now you can convert the Miracles that you didn't use that day into something else as easy as just pressing the convert miracle button. What will the Miracles turn into? Jump right into the demo and give it a shot to find out!

VFX on Emergency Events: We have also added a sprinkle of VFXs on the Emergency Events to feast your eyes.

Polish on Units and Pests Animation: Some Units and Pests animation has been polished to make them all more lively.

Skip Animation when Pests Appear: We have also added a QOL update on the demo, now you can skip the animation on the appearance of the Pests.

Plus, we've squashed a bunch of bugs to make your experience smoother than ever.


We hope you enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed creating it. We eagerly await your feedback to further enhance this game!

Also you can be part of our Discord Community by joining with the link below:
Grow the Seed's Discord Community

Keep growing and thriving, and as always, happy planting! 
Grow your plant, plan your growth!

notes.title: Grow the Seed Major Demo Update v.3.0.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43731981/d439487b4cbd4c3a8f987af79d0925e69dd92307.png


Hello everyone~ 

With great joy, we announce the latest update for the Grow the Seed Demo! In this new version, developed with love and passion, we have addressed various issues that needed fixing.

Change list:


New UI Visual: We've listened to your feedback and worked hard to make the HUD more compact and tidy. Now, you'll have a clearer view of your seed and surroundings, making your tree-growing experience even more immersive.

New Turn-Based Pest Battle: Say goodbye to the old chaotic pest battles! We've transformed Pest Battle into a turn-based system, allowing you to strategize and plan your moves as pests move or attack once per day.

Introducing the Weapon Card: Directly fend off those pesky pests by using Weapon Card to launch direct attacks and keep your tree safe.

Upgraded Card System: It's time to level up your cards! With blessings from Mother Nature, all your cards can now be upgraded to unleash their full potential.

Blessing System: Embrace the power of Mother Nature! Bless your chosen cards to upgrade, duplicate, transform, or even bid farewell to them if needed.

Tools System: Surviving just got easier! Collect handy tools for permanent effects that'll aid you on your tree-growing journey.

Merchant System: Harvest your fruits and earn coins to splurge on a variety of cards and tools at our merchant shop.

Quests System : At some point on your journey a mysterious Spirit will ask for your help. Lend a hand and receive some intriguing rewards in return!

Plus, we've spruced up the game with lots of polish, added some eye-catching visual effects, and squashed a bunch of bugs to make your experience smoother than ever.


We hope you enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed creating it. We eagerly await your feedback to further enhance this game!

Also you can be part of our Discord Community by joining with the link below:
Discord

Keep growing and thriving, and as always, happy planting! 
Grow your plant, plan your growth!

notes.title: Grow the Seed Demo Update v.2.0.0 - New Systems!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43731981/53ff8bfdedd327e4181cca9225863a7a69a5e5c1.png
Hey everyone!🎮✨

We're thrilled to announce the release of our latest update for Grow the Seed demo! In this version, we've been hard at work nurturing the game's core experience with new features, improvements, balancing, all while tending to those pesky crashes that needed weeding out.
Changelist

 Added Season Calendar - survive until week 5, and choose your own path & challenge each week.
 Added Defensive Units - a bunch of friendly insects are coming to your aid. Shelter them and they will assist you to fight the pests.
 Added a lot of visual effect improvements, particles, animation, weather effects, etc.
 Fixed the crash issue.
 Fixed lots of game-breaking bugs.
 Changed how Fruits works - now fruit will give you Fruit Currency that can be used to buy things that can help your survival.
 Reworked Quest system - now quests are optional and will reward you +1 Max Miracle upon each completion.

We hope you enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed creating it. Your feedback is like water to our thirsty roots, so keep it coming!

Happy Growing!
